title: Demo account security policy
text: This fictional policy requires MFA for administrator accounts. Never share one-time passwords. Contact the help desk to recover access.

title: Demo expense policy
text: This fictional policy asks employees to submit receipts within 30 days. A manager must approve reimbursement before payment.

title: Demo support request guide
text: Use a request ID such as REQ-1001 to check a fictional support request. This demo cannot create, modify, or close requests.
